blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, prevent the next 5 damage that would be dealt this turn to any number of targets, divided as you choose.

needs.what: a prevention op that installs an absorb-N shield (a pool that drains as it prevents: 'prevent the next N damage that would be dealt this turn') on players and/or permanents, with the total N divided among any number of 'any target' targets as the controller chooses on putting the trigger on the stack (601.2d division, as damage's `divided` does), each target's shield preventing only its own share
needs.why_existing_wont_do: prevent_damage (players) and prevent_damage_permanent (permanents) only prevent ALL damage for a duration -- the engine docstring says there is deliberately no `amount` and the loader refuses one; neither can be divided across targets or mix a player and a permanent target. `damage` has `divided` but deals damage, it does not prevent it. Flash (keyword), convoke (`pay_generic_with: "tap_creatures"`, which honours coloured pips) and flying are all expressible; only this line is blocked
